minutes.headline: Finance Committee voted its warrant recommendations, backing the omnibus budget and capital plan; the Pierce APR passed 4-2-1.
minutes.summary: The committee held the FY22 budget public hearing, heard the town manager's presentation, then voted recommendations on each annual town meeting warrant article by roll call. It then edited its warrant letter to residents. Several articles with unknown amounts were deferred, and the capital plan was voted with one abstention after a debate about the school fire alarm.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted by roll call to recommend the omnibus budget article, with every member voting aye.
The capital plan article was recommended with one abstention, after a debate that included funding for the school fire alarm.
The agricultural preservation restriction article was recommended 4-2 with one abstention.
Collective bargaining articles, the old primary school design article and the design funding article were deferred to town meeting rather than recommended.
The committee agreed to take up school fire alarm funding on April 8 with the fire chief invited, then edited its warrant letter to residents.

why_it_matters: These recommendations are the Finance Committee's advice to voters on the articles that set the town's FY22 spending, capital projects and transfers to reserve funds, and residents will be asked to vote on those articles at annual town meeting.

The deferred articles, including collective bargaining and old primary school design funding, carry no committee recommendation yet, so their amounts and effect on the tax bill remain open until town meeting.
